verdicts.rationale: The introduction explicitly describes degradation from imperfect modalities, failures to detect or adapt to imperfections, and difficulties under substantial train–test discrepancies.
The methodology specifies volumetric processing, separate modality extractors, ICEM/CDAM assessment, pixel-level discounting, and DS fusion.
Equations (5)–(7) describe evidence SVD, the minimum L1 distance divided by class count against stored training spectra, and convolutional combination.
Equations (9)–(11) and their explanation establish differential evidence, concatenation and convolutions, and lower weights with greater discrepancies.
The module combines both information sources with α and β set to 1, then merges discounted opinions through Reduced Dempster’s Combination Rule.
The dataset description supplies all four modalities, 1251 scans, and the stated training, validation, and testing counts.
The patient count, diagnoses, three phases, annotation targets, and Elastix registration reference phase all match.
The implementation details explicitly report the stated training schedule, crop size, sliding-window overlap, and evaluation metrics.
The comparison protocol and qualified performance statements accurately reflect the reported text.
Figure 2 lists the exact σ values and both datasets; its accompanying discussion reports highest Dice and lowest HD95 under noisy conditions.
The text explicitly reports both corruption settings, eight comparison models, and superiority across standard BraTS metrics.
The ablation discussion gives the stated N-T1Gd Model3 scores and baseline scores in the same ET, TC, WT order.
The reported Model4 scores and comparison with Models1–3 match, including the explicit N-T1Gd exception.
The clinical analysis explicitly identifies both scanners, distribution shifts, degraded segmentation quality, and retained anatomical consistency.
The discussion explicitly acknowledges this limitation even when discount factors approach 1.
The contribution statements describe all three modules, dynamic pixel-level modality calibration, both datasets, and both comparator categories.
